StrongRef.title: StrongRef
StrongRef.description: A reference to a specific version of a record: its AT URI and the CID of that version (`com.atproto.repo.strongRef`).

cid.description: CID of the referenced record version.

Label.title: Label
Label.description: A moderation label applied to an account or a record (`com.atproto.label.defs#label`). Only the fields every label carries are declared.

src.description: DID of the labeler that applied the label.

uri.description: AT URI of the labeled record, or the DID of the labeled account.

cid.description: CID of the labeled record version, when the label is version-specific.

val.description: The label value, such as `porn` or `!hide`.

neg.description: Whether this label negates an earlier label with the same `src`, `uri` and `val`.

exp.description: When the label expires, if it does.

ViewerState.title: ViewerState
ViewerState.description: The relationship between the authenticated viewer and this account (`app.bsky.actor.defs#viewerState`). Without credentials the public AppView sends an empty or absent object.

muted.description: Whether the viewer has muted this account.

mutedByList.description: The list through which the account is muted, when it is (`app.bsky.graph.defs#listViewBasic`). Kept as a map.

additionalProperties.description: A field of the list view.

blockedBy.description: Whether this account blocks the viewer.

blocking.description: AT URI of the viewer's block record against this account, when there is one.

blockingByList.description: The list through which the account is blocked, when it is (`app.bsky.graph.defs#listViewBasic`). Kept as a map.

additionalProperties.description: A field of the list view.

following.description: AT URI of the viewer's follow record for this account, when there is one.

followedBy.description: AT URI of this account's follow record for the viewer, when there is one.

knownFollowers.description: Followers of this account the viewer also follows (`app.bsky.actor.defs#knownFollowers`). Kept as a map.

additionalProperties.description: A field of the known-followers view.

ProfileViewBasic.title: ProfileViewBasic
ProfileViewBasic.description: The smallest profile view, embedded as an author in posts (`app.bsky.actor.defs#profileViewBasic`).

did.description: The account's DID, its permanent identifier.

handle.description: The account's current handle, such as `bsky.app`; `handle.invalid` when it does not resolve.

avatar.description: URL of the avatar image, when set.

associated.description: Counts and flags for associated objects: lists, feed generators, starter packs, labeler and chat settings (`app.bsky.actor.defs#profileAssociated`). Kept as a map.

additionalProperties.description: A field of the associated block.

viewer.description: The viewer's relationship with this account.

ProfileView.title: ProfileView
ProfileView.description: A profile as listed in search results and follow graphs (`app.bsky.actor.defs#profileView`).

did.description: The account's DID, its permanent identifier.

handle.description: The account's current handle, such as `bsky.app`; `handle.invalid` when it does not resolve.

avatar.description: URL of the avatar image, when set.

associated.description: Counts and flags for associated objects: lists, feed generators, starter packs, labeler and chat settings (`app.bsky.actor.defs#profileAssociated`). Kept as a map.

additionalProperties.description: A field of the associated block.

viewer.description: The viewer's relationship with this account.

indexedAt.description: When the AppView last indexed the profile record.

did.description: The account's DID, its permanent identifier.

handle.description: The account's current handle, such as `bsky.app`; `handle.invalid` when it does not resolve.

avatar.description: URL of the avatar image, when set.

associated.description: Counts and flags for associated objects: lists, feed generators, starter packs, labeler and chat settings (`app.bsky.actor.defs#profileAssociated`). Kept as a map.

additionalProperties.description: A field of the associated block.

viewer.description: The viewer's relationship with this account.

banner.description: URL of the banner image, when set.

followersCount.description: Number of accounts following this one.

followsCount.description: Number of accounts this one follows.

postsCount.description: Number of posts by this account.

indexedAt.description: When the AppView last indexed the profile record.

pinnedPost.description: The post pinned to the top of the profile, when there is one.

Facet.title: Facet
Facet.description: A rich-text annotation over a byte range of `text` (`app.bsky.richtext.facet`): a mention, a link or a hashtag.

index.title: ByteSlice
index.description: The annotated byte range of `text`, UTF-8, end exclusive.

byteEnd.description: Byte after the last byte of the range.

features.description: What the range is. A list because one range can carry more than one feature, though in practice it carries exactly one.

items.title: FacetFeature
items.description: One feature, tagged by `$type`. The three shapes share this schema rather than being an `anyOf`, because the tag and the payload field are one-to-one: `#mention` carries `did`, `#link` carries `uri`, `#tag` carries `tag`, and exactly one of the three is present.

uri.description: Where a `#link` points. Absolute, and not necessarily the text it covers: `truewire.dev` in the post can point at `https://truewire.dev`.

did.description: Who a `#mention` refers to. A DID, not a handle -- a handle can be reassigned, so the mention is resolved when the post is written and stays pointing at the same account.

tag.description: The hashtag a `#tag` carries, without the leading `#`.

PostRecord.title: PostRecord
PostRecord.description: The post record as its author wrote it (`app.bsky.feed.post`). An open object: the fields declared here are the ones every post carries plus the common optional ones; a client may put more in.

$type.description: Lexicon type tag of this object.

text.description: The post text, at most 300 graphemes.

createdAt.description: When the author's client says the post was written. Client-supplied, unlike `indexedAt` on the view.

langs.description: BCP 47 language tags of the text, when the client set them.

reply.title: ReplyRef
reply.description: Which thread the post replies into, when it is a reply.

embed.title: RecordEmbed
embed.description: The embed as written in the record (images, external link, quoted record, video), tagged by `$type`. Kept as it came; the hydrated `embed` on the post view is the typed one.

AspectRatio.title: AspectRatio
AspectRatio.description: Width and height of a media item, as a ratio.

$type.description: Lexicon type tag of this object.

items.title: ImageView
items.description: One image with its CDN URLs.

alt.description: Alt text; empty when none was given.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio, when the client recorded one.

$type.description: Lexicon type tag of this object.

thumb.description: URL of the card image, when there is one.

$type.description: Lexicon type tag of this object.

thumbnail.description: URL of the poster image, when there is one.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio, when the client recorded one.

$type.description: Lexicon type tag of this object.

record.description: The quoted record's view, tagged by `$type`: a post (`#viewRecord`), a not-found, blocked or detached marker, or a feed generator, list, labeler or starter pack view. Kept as a map.

additionalProperties.description: A field of the quoted view.

$type.description: Lexicon type tag of this object.

UnknownEmbedView.title: UnknownEmbedView
UnknownEmbedView.description: An embed whose `$type` this spec does not model, kept so one unknown embed does not fail the page it arrived on (`app.bsky.embed.gallery#view` appeared in a feed while this client was being written). Only the tag survives validation; the payload is dropped, and `validate=False` returns it whole.

EmbedView.title: EmbedView
EmbedView.description: The hydrated embed of a post, tagged by `$type` (`app.bsky.embed.*#view`). The union is open: a tag none of the modelled members carries validates as `UnknownEmbedView` rather than failing the post.

anyOf.description: Anything else the AppView tags an embed with.

PostView.title: PostView
PostView.description: A post as the AppView serves it: the record plus its author, counts and hydrated embed (`app.bsky.feed.defs#postView`).

cid.description: CID of the post record version.

embed.description: The hydrated embed, when the post has one.

indexedAt.description: When the AppView indexed this version of the post.

viewer.description: The viewer's own like, repost and mute state on the post (`app.bsky.feed.defs#viewerState`). Kept as a map; empty without credentials.

additionalProperties.description: A field of the viewer state.

threadgate.description: The thread's reply gate, when the root post has one (`app.bsky.feed.defs#threadgateView`). Kept as a map.

additionalProperties.description: A field of the threadgate view.

NotFoundPost.title: NotFoundPost
NotFoundPost.description: A post that does not exist or was deleted (`app.bsky.feed.defs#notFoundPost`).

$type.description: Lexicon type tag of this object.

uri.description: AT URI that was asked for.

BlockedPost.title: BlockedPost
BlockedPost.description: A post hidden by a block between the viewer and its author (`app.bsky.feed.defs#blockedPost`).

$type.description: Lexicon type tag of this object.

uri.description: AT URI of the hidden post.

author.title: BlockedAuthor
author.description: The hidden post's author, reduced to its DID.

viewer.description: The viewer's relationship with the author.

ReplyRefPost.title: ReplyRefPost
ReplyRefPost.description: A post referenced from a reply chain: the post view, or a marker that it is gone or blocked.

FeedViewPost.title: FeedViewPost
FeedViewPost.description: One feed entry: a post, plus why it is in the feed (`app.bsky.feed.defs#feedViewPost`).

reply.title: FeedReplyRef
reply.description: The thread context of a reply (`app.bsky.feed.defs#replyRef`).

grandparentAuthor.description: Author of the parent's parent, when the parent is itself a reply.

reason.title: FeedReason
reason.description: Why the post is in the feed when it is not the author's own: a repost, or a pin.

$type.description: Lexicon type tag of this object.

anyOf.title: ReasonPin
anyOf.description: The post is pinned to the profile (`app.bsky.feed.defs#reasonPin`).

$type.description: Lexicon type tag of this object.

feedContext.description: Opaque context from the feed generator, to echo back in interaction reports.

ThreadNode.title: ThreadNode
ThreadNode.description: A parent or reply in a thread: the post, or a marker that it is gone or blocked. Its own `parent` and `replies` are not typed here, so a validated thread keeps one level around the root; `validate=False` returns the whole tree.

anyOf.title: ThreadPost
anyOf.description: A post one level from the root (`app.bsky.feed.defs#threadViewPost`, without its own `parent`/`replies`).

$type.description: Lexicon type tag of this object.

ThreadViewPost.title: ThreadViewPost
ThreadViewPost.description: The requested post with its ancestors and replies (`app.bsky.feed.defs#threadViewPost`).

$type.description: Lexicon type tag of this object.

parent.description: The post replied to, when this is a reply and `parentHeight` allowed it.

threadgate.description: The thread's reply gate, when the root has one (`app.bsky.feed.defs#threadgateView`). Kept as a map.

additionalProperties.description: A field of the threadgate view.

RepoCommit.title: RepoCommit
RepoCommit.description: One commit to a repository: every write returns the commit that carried it, which is how a caller orders its own writes against the firehose.

rev.description: Revision of the repository after it.
